tei:div.tei:head: Yom Zeh Mekhubad
tei:div.tei:p:
This day is the most precious of all days,
Because on it the Eternal ceased from work.

Six days you are to perform all your work,
But the seventh day is your God’s Sabbath;
On it you must not do any labor,
For in six days he accomplished all things.

tei:p.tei:hi: This day is the most precious of all days…

tei:div.tei:p:
It is foremost among the holy feasts,
The day of rest, the holy Sabbath day;
Hence, let each recite Kiddush over wine,
Let the faithful say grace over the twin loaves.

tei:p.tei:hi: This day is the most precious of all days…

tei:div.tei:p:
Come, enjoy the dainties and drink the sweet,
For God provides for all who cling to him
Clothes to wear and portions of nourishment,
Meat and fish and all luxurious foods.

tei:p.tei:hi: This day is the most precious of all days…

tei:div.tei:p:
You shall not be in want of anything;
When you have eaten and are satisfied,
You shall bless the Lord your God whom you love,
For he has blessed you above all people.

tei:p.tei:hi: This day is the most precious of all days…

tei:div.tei:p:
The heavens declare his glory,
The earth is full of his kindness;
Lo, his hand has made all these things!
He is God, whose work is perfect!

tei:p.tei:hi: This day is the most precious of all days…
